name: CinemaCity Quality Lab
description: CinemaCity Quality Lab with HD entitlement probe. Besides Auto/HLS variant inspection, it checks the user's own session against the official DH sizes endpoint and two byte ranges to determine whether an HD download channel is actually authorized.

scrapers.name: CinemaCity Quality · Login Session
scrapers.description: Experimental quality resolver + HDPROBE diagnostic. HDPROBE reports whether the current configured CinemaCity session exposes HD file metadata and supports arbitrary byte ranges; it does not use shared/leaked credentials.
